provenance.limits: Elemental FCC, BCC or SC parent lattices only; compounds are not approximated. All particles are finite, ideal and unrelaxed. Shapes do not establish stability, segregation or environmental equilibrium. Twisted rods deform the lattice; helicoidal ribbons cut an undeformed lattice with a rotating envelope. Neither is a validated growth model or an experimentally assigned helicoid phase. Curved/deformed boundaries have no single Miller facet. Dimensions bound atom centers, not rendered atomic radii. Maximum 20,000 retained atoms.
